_doc: Claude Desktop adds a remote MCP server in Settings, Connectors, Add custom connector: enter https://emem.dev/mcp and no file is needed. The config file claude_desktop_config.json starts local (stdio) servers only, so this entry runs the mcp-remote bridge. Install Node.js first. File locations: macOS ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json, Windows %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json. Restart Claude Desktop after you save.
